name: Wings of Flying

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Spread the wings
powers.text: Magic action: the cloak becomes wings: a Fly Speed of 60 ft for 1 hour (once per dawn).

summary: The cloak becomes bat or bird wings: fly at 60 ft for an hour, once a day.
text: Wearing this cloak, use a Magic action to transform it into wings sprouting from your back, granting a 60-foot Fly Speed. They last 1 hour, or until you dismiss them with another Magic action. Once the wings vanish, they can't be used again for 1d12 hours.
